name: machinaut-pr-action
description: GitHub Action that posts an agent-authored PR's Lodestar evidence trail as a sticky Machinaut comment (Track C, Increment 1).
author: Machinise

scripts.check-dist: npm run build && git diff --exit-code --stat -- dist/ || (echo '::error::dist/ is out of date — run npm run build and commit' && exit 1)
scripts.all: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
